name: @avatark/narrative-ir-adapter
description: Translation contracts between the canonical Narrative IR (studiok-specifications) and runtime-neutral host contracts. First capability: DELIBERATE_NON_ACTION (ArtifactReference, RuntimeCapabilities, ActionOpportunity, NonActionQualification, deriveNonActionQualification) -- world-agnostic, host-agnostic, persistence-agnostic, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
